body:
FIRST TIME USE. (Think it's legal, checked, still don't know).
Held button on vaporizer, took a long drag. Didn't get a mouth feel from smoke and was surprised at the immense cloudy vapor starting to come out. Took a deep breath to inhale, held it, and breathed it out.
Got a light raspberry flavour (that is from the flavoured brand, [ ]).
Felt a slight immediate head effect. Began to feel relaxed and nice.
Took a few more drags and mouth-only inhales.
Relaxation remained for 40 minutes. Upswings of restful feeling and relaxation at each mouth-only and lung drag. Took 4 lung drags total, 5 mouth drags over first 20 minutes.
Feel a withdrawal effect after 40 minutes. Had a slight inability to get the letters CBD straight (was confusing with CDB (still am)). Had difficulty figuring out that 8:09 to 8:50 was (approximately) 40 minutes. Needed to pause and think harder.
Did not receive noticeable pain relief, though pain has not significantly increased upon lying down (it does intermittently, so it's not known if inflammation was relieved or suppressed or not).
Feel slightly nauseous and withdrawal feeling might be fatigued of trying more CDB.
Not sure if withdrawal is typical of CDB use or if it is only indicative of first time use.
